text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original control flow, including `ReadWanted` breaking only its own loop so subdirectories are still queued. They also keep the same exception filters and `unread` entries, and the `CHA0004` pragma still wraps every catch block. `Files` is left with just the `while` and one `if`, well under 15, and I see nothing that would add a build warning. This review is from the diff alone; I did not build the project or run the tests.
